authorization: O dono apontou pixels deslocados e granulação na folha idle de J.J., pediu ajuste fino e estabeleceu a busca por qualidade AAA como objetivo das funções do agente. Em nova prancha, o dono reportou recidiva de halo/recorte sujo no Joe Musashi e pediu revisão obrigatória em toda proposta do roster; o estudo de recorte transparente gerado depois também foi rejeitado por franja cromática.

lessons.lesson: Uma folha pode passar em paleta e conectividade e ainda conter pixels de cor incompatível presos à silhueta. Para cada pose, revise recorte e agrupamento no tamanho nativo e em ampliação nearest-neighbor; declare cores por material nas regiões suscetíveis e rode audit_sprite_cutout.py. Qualidade AAA é objetivo aspiracional para o agente perseguir em cada função, não claim de entrega: aprovação visual, integração e evidências executáveis continuam necessárias. A component-only pass is not a clean-cutout verdict: the Joe Musashi review exposed a profile-schema gap and an owner-visible halo despite a limited detached-component check; valid material-region review plus human inspection remains mandatory.
lessons.root_cause: A folha v4 passou nos gates de recursos e animação, e cada figura era um único componente conectado. Mesmo assim, 13 pixels #AA5555 ficaram no limite superior do cabelo em 9 quadros: cor da sombra da pele ligada diagonalmente ao contorno azul, não ruído detectado por componentes. A regra genérica de speckle não mede compatibilidade do pixel com o material local.

evidence.regions_checked: visible_bbox_top, x=0..95 and y=0..5 in every 96x96 frame; permitted navy/blue/violet/white hair and outline colors
evidence.diff_result: exactly 13 old opaque pixels became transparent; zero added pixels, zero recolored pixels, no rescaling or pose changes
evidence.old_sheet_gate: FAIL: audit_sprite_cutout.py reports 13 off-material pixels in the declared hair region
evidence.new_sheet_gates: PASS: audit_sprite_cutout.py; audit_validate_resources.py (13 useful SMS colors, no dithering); audit_animation_semantics.py (12 unique frames, geometry and common baseline)
evidence.rejected_methods: ImageGen edit altered morphology and outlines; broad 18% multi-corner floodfill erased legitimate light details. Neither output was used.
evidence.limits: The region gate checks declared material colors and disconnected components, not full visual fidelity. The v5 sheet awaits separate owner approval and has no ROM/emulator validation. AAA remains a target, not a certification.

followup_joe_musashi_2026_10_04.owner_visual_result: fail: owner identified dirty/haloed cutout around Joe Musashi in roster review
followup_joe_musashi_2026_10_04.direct_cutout_audit_result: Existing v2 asset contract is not in audit_sprite_cutout schema; invocation stopped because sheet.columns/rows/frame_px are absent.
followup_joe_musashi_2026_10_04.limited_component_probe: Temporary adapter with 12px minimum component and the entire character palette allowed returned PASS; this only measured detached islands and did not test material colors or explain the visible halo.
followup_joe_musashi_2026_10_04.learning: A component-only pass is not a clean-cutout verdict. Require a valid material-region profile and human inspection of transparent source at 1x and nearest-neighbor 4x on contrasting backgrounds.
followup_joe_musashi_2026_10_04.sprite_owner_approval: not approved; morphology is a reference only, cutout revision remains open
followup_joe_musashi_2026_10_04.cutout_audit_self_check: PASS: tool self-check covers detached components and material-region colors; it does not judge full visual fidelity.

imagegen_cutout_study.result: rejected: red/colored edge fringe remains after requested transparent-background cleanup
imagegen_cutout_study.decision: Do not equate imagegen transparency with a clean cutout; inspect on light and dark backgrounds and run a valid material-region profile.

lessons.limits: The 2026-10-04 Joe component-only probe used all palette colors as allowed and cannot prove a clean edge; owner flagged its cutout for revision.

note_ids.mastery: A material-region palette catches attached off-material flecks that connectivity misses. Extend region profiles only where the model sheet can define them; retain owner visual review for the rest of the silhouette.
